parsed.explanation: The dossier has no trans-specific material, so I extrapolate from structural signals. In government-controlled areas, same-sex conduct carries prison terms and prosecutions are described as regular, and Article 410 adds police surveillance. In insurgent-held areas and a southern regional administration, death is a recorded possible penalty, and a non-state armed group has documented killings of people alleged to be gay (2017, 2018, 2024, raw counts without denominator). Stigma is severe, there is no anti-discrimination protection, no recourse, and no visible community infrastructure. Visitors who are outed face a state lever plus armed-group lethal risk with weak remedy. Frequency is unquantified and the penalty is contested, so I stop short of the severe-risk floor. Border, facility, and care rules are unsourced and remain open questions, not offsets.
